example_h: See where every rupiah of PPh 21 goes
example_p: PPh 21 is the income tax withheld from salaries. This ledger is one employee on the monthly effective rate scheme (TER), paid for twelve months with no bonus. Pick a monthly gross and a PTKP status, the non-taxable income set by family status.
noscript: Switching the inputs needs JavaScript. This is the default case.
fig_monthly: Withheld each month, January to November
prose_sample: Sample inputs, not a real payslip. PKP is taxable income after PTKP. The ledger is produced by pph21.ts, the rule file the calculator runs.

rules_h: Rules that come from DJP’s own book
rules_p1: The PPh 21 and PPh 26 calculators cite Buku PPh 21/26, the guide from the Directorate General of Taxes (DJP) released on 8 January 2024. Each result comes with a step-by-step table and a formula narrative, so you can follow the rule instead of trusting a total.
rules_p2: The rule files sit in the repository next to the calculators, one per tax, written as plain functions. The app ships the guide too: Buku PPh 21/26, release 8 January 2024 (PDF).
privacy_h: Your numbers stay on your device
privacy_p1: Open Pajak runs entirely in your browser, with no backend. It asks for numbers and transaction types, never for NIK, names or addresses.
privacy_p2: Save a calculation as a receipt and it stays in your browser’s local storage. Export receipts to Excel or PDF, or upload a spreadsheet to create a batch of receipts offline.
